Welcome to Korean NTR Stories, where you can read about the hidden side of Korean celebrities.

The first part depicts the wholesome life the girls share with their significant other. You could make up a pairing, ask the AI to make one up, or simply go with a solo scenario that explores the fulfilling careers of these Korean stars. Include a {#1} at the end of the prompt to designate that it's a prompt for part one. You can continue the part if you want by adding more {#1} follow up prompts. You can make suggestions or leave it to the bot, but include {#2} at the end of the prompt asking for the hidden side.

You should include the 한글 (Hangul) names of the characters if possible. Including the ages of the celebrity and their significant other can improve the Korean speech patterns the bot will generate.

data.creator_notes:
This bot probably won't work with dumb LLMs. It's created for and tested with Deepseek R1 (free), using openrouter. There were two inspirations for this. First, the fact that Deepseek R1 could actually speak conversational Korean at a high level, including all the most obscene sexual slang. Second, K-pop Pornovision by @hytoth.

My spin on this idea is a form of "two panel NTR" in text based form. You know those NTR short comics that show you one panel that is all wholesome, and then the second panel is the contrast and payoff where it shows the NTR corrupted girl? This is basically that. I'm sorry if BBC isn't your thing, because it's kind of baked into the definitions... Also, the definitions are defined for female celebrities. I made it mostly for myself, so I didn't bother making it unisex gender definitions.

Deepseek is really fucking good at writing Korean, but it's not perfect. I was surprised that it inherently has an understanding of respectful vs casual speech, but it could still gets the speaking dynamics wrong at times, so I spent a large part of the bot trying to guide it in that department. Anyways, it will translate everything, so you can still use the bot if you don't speak Korean at all.

Ask for a story about some Korean Idol/celeb and write {#1} at the end. Then ask for the hidden side of her (you could elaborate specifics too) and write {#2} at the end.

The example dialogues are long as fuck because I'm a lazy ass and just copied this AI's own message lol. AI picture is just some quick work I churned out. Didn't want to use a real image of someone for this.

I have a private Blacked lorebook I use whenever I want to do a BBC run through any bot, but it has some brainrotted and very niche aspects to it that I don't think fits a general release lol. This bot should work fine without a lorebook, but you can add whatever you want to it if you want something more in that department.
